title: Pull the plug clear before water starts
problem: The short retained plug shot has mostly sustained hand contact; a water jet follows quickly. Preserve a readable hand-to-plug separation rather than letting the jet conceal disposal.
beats: Roshan closes one hand on the visible mouth obstruction.
She pulls it wholly clear of the spout and holds it to the side.
The first small stream emerges only from the unblocked mouth.
end_state: The detached obstruction stays in Roshan’s hand and a small clear stream reaches the pool.
must_not_move: blue/lavender seahorse, violet crest, peach belly, curled tail, coral pedestal and pool edge
negative_constraints: no redrawn yellow seahorse, dissolving plug, duplicate hand or independent fountain basin
